174: static void px_blend(int x, int y, uint8_t a, uint32_t rgb)
175: {
176:   if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= SCR_W || y >= SCR_H || a == 0) return;
177: 
178:   uint32_t bg  = scr_buf[y * SCR_W + x];
179:   uint8_t  br  = U8(bg, 16);
180:   uint8_t  bgn = U8(bg, 8);
181:   uint8_t  bb  = U8(bg, 0);
182:   uint8_t  fr  = U8(rgb, 16);
183:   uint8_t  fg  = U8(rgb, 8);
184:   uint8_t  fb  = U8(rgb, 0);
185: 
186:   uint8_t r = (uint8_t)((fr * a + br  * (255 - a)) / 255);
187:   uint8_t g = (uint8_t)((fg * a + bgn * (255 - a)) / 255);
188:   uint8_t b = (uint8_t)((fb * a + bb  * (255 - a)) / 255);
189: 
190:   scr_buf[y * SCR_W + x] = (255u << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
191: }

193: static void fill_rrect(float cx, float cy, const shape_t *s, uint32_t rgb)
194: {
195:   float hw = s->hw;
196:   float hh = s->hh;
197:   float r  = s->r;
198:   int   x;
199:   int   y;
200: 
201:   if (r > hw) r = hw;
202:   if (r > hh) r = hh;
203:   if (hw < 1.0f || hh < 1.0f) return;
204: 
205:   float th = s->rot * PI / 180.0f;
206:   float cs = cosf(th);
207:   float sn = sinf(th);
208:   float ext = sqrtf(hw * hw + hh * hh) + 3.0f;
209: 
210:   int x0 = (int)(cx - ext);
211:   int x1 = (int)(cx + ext) + 1;
212:   int y0 = (int)(cy - ext);
213:   int y1 = (int)(cy + ext) + 1;
214: 
215:   if (x0 < 0)     x0 = 0;
216:   if (y0 < 0)     y0 = 0;
217:   if (x1 > SCR_W) x1 = SCR_W;
218:   if (y1 > SCR_H) y1 = SCR_H;
219: 
220:   for (y = y0; y < y1; y++)
221:     {
222:       for (x = x0; x < x1; x++)
223:         {
224:           float dx = (x + 0.5f) - cx;
225:           float dy = (y + 0.5f) - cy;
226: 
227:           /* 屏幕 -> 局部(逆旋转) */
228:           float lx =  dx * cs + dy * sn;
229:           float ly = -dx * sn + dy * cs;
230: 
231:           float qx = fabsf(lx) - (hw - r);
232:           float qy = fabsf(ly) - (hh - r);
233:           float mx = (qx > 0) ? qx : 0;
234:           float my = (qy > 0) ? qy : 0;
235:           float outside = sqrtf(mx * mx + my * my);
236:           float inside  = (qx > qy) ? qx : qy;
237: 
238:           if (inside > 0) inside = 0;
239: 
240:           float d = outside + inside - r;
241:           float a = 0.5f - d;
242: 
243:           if (a <= 0) continue;
244:           if (a > 1) a = 1;
245: 
246:           px_blend(x, y, (uint8_t)(a * 255), rgb);
247:         }
248:     }
249: }

384: /* 把一只眼睛的外接矩形并入脏区(用外接圆, 覆盖任意旋转) */
385: static void union_eye_area(lv_area_t *a, float cx, float cy,
386:                            const shape_t *s)
387: {
388:   float ext = sqrtf(s->hw * s->hw + s->hh * s->hh) + 4.0f;
389:   int   x1 = (int)(cx - ext);
390:   int   y1 = (int)(cy - ext);
391:   int   x2 = (int)(cx + ext) + 1;
392:   int   y2 = (int)(cy + ext) + 1;
393: 
394:   if (x1 < 0)         x1 = 0;
395:   if (y1 < 0)         y1 = 0;
396:   if (x2 > SCR_W - 1) x2 = SCR_W - 1;
397:   if (y2 > SCR_H - 1) y2 = SCR_H - 1;
398: 
399:   if (x1 < a->x1) a->x1 = x1;
400:   if (y1 < a->y1) a->y1 = y1;
401:   if (x2 > a->x2) a->x2 = x2;
402:   if (y2 > a->y2) a->y2 = y2;
403: }

405: static void anim_cb(lv_timer_t *tm)
406: {
407:   (void)tm;
408:   uint32_t tick = lv_tick_get();
409:   int      i;
410: 
411:   /* 来自 HTTP 线程的表情切换请求(必须在 LVGL 主线程应用) */
412:   if (g_pending_expr >= 0)
413:     {
414:       set_expr(g_pending_expr);
415:       g_pending_expr = -1;
416:     }
417: 
418:   /* 设置页打开时眼睛被完全遮挡, 跳过渲染省算力 */
419:   if (g_set_open)
420:     {
421:       g_need_full = 1;
422:       return;
423:     }
424: 
425:   if (!g_need_full)
426:     {
427:       /* 局部模式: 只清上一帧的脏区, 不整屏清 */
428:       if (g_dirty_valid) clear_area(&g_dirty_prev);
429:     }
430:   else
431:     {
432:       /* 整屏模式 */
433:       for (i = 0; i < SCR_W * SCR_H; i++) scr_buf[i] = 0xFF000000;
434:     }
435: 
436:   /* 眨眼调度 */
437:   if (tick > g_next_blink && tick > g_blink_until)
438:     {
439:       g_blink_until = tick + 160;
440:       g_next_blink  = tick + 2200 + (rand() % 2800);
441:     }
442: 
443:   shape_t L;
444:   shape_t R;
445:   int     blinking;
446: 
447:   compute_target(g_expr, tick, &L, &R, &blinking);
448:   if (blinking)
449:     {
450:       g_curL = BLINK;
451:       g_curR = BLINK;
452:     }
453:   else
454:     {
455:       lerp_shape(&g_curL, &L, 0.22f);
456:       lerp_shape(&g_curR, &R, 0.22f);
457:     }
458: 
459:   g_lookx += (g_lookx_t - g_lookx) * 0.18f;
460:   g_looky += (g_looky_t - g_looky) * 0.18f;
461: 
462:   float cxL = SCR_W / 2.0f - EYE_GAP + g_lookx * 26.0f + g_curL.dx;
463:   float cxR = SCR_W / 2.0f + EYE_GAP + g_lookx * 26.0f + g_curR.dx;
464:   float cyL = EYE_CY + g_looky * 20.0f + g_curL.dy;
465:   float cyR = EYE_CY + g_looky * 20.0f + g_curR.dy;
466: 
467:   fill_rrect(cxL, cyL, &g_curL, 0xFFFFFF);
468:   fill_rrect(cxR, cyR, &g_curR, 0xFFFFFF);
469: 
470:   /* 只把眼睛占用的这块区域标脏 —— LVGL 会只刷这一块,
471:      SPI 屏驱动支持窗口寻址(LCD_SetWindows), 传输量随之大减 */
472:   lv_area_t dirty;
473: 
474:   dirty.x1 = SCR_W - 1;
475:   dirty.y1 = SCR_H - 1;
476:   dirty.x2 = 0;
477:   dirty.y2 = 0;
478:   union_eye_area(&dirty, cxL, cyL, &g_curL);
479:   union_eye_area(&dirty, cxR, cyR, &g_curR);
480: 
481:   if (g_need_full)
482:     {
483:       lv_obj_invalidate(scr_cv);
484:       g_need_full = 0;
485:     }
486:   else
487:     {
488:       if (g_dirty_valid) lv_obj_invalidate_area(scr_cv, &g_dirty_prev);
489:       lv_obj_invalidate_area(scr_cv, &dirty);
490:     }
491: 
492:   g_dirty_prev  = dirty;
493:   g_dirty_valid = 1;
494: }

496: /****************************************************************************
497:  * 网络: 获取本机 IP + 连接状态
498:  ****************************************************************************/
499: 
500: static int get_local_ip(char *out, int n)
501: {
502:   int            fd;
503:   struct ifreq   ifr;
504:   struct sockaddr_in *sin;
505:   int            rc;
506: 
507:   fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
508:   if (fd < 0) return 0;
509: 
510:   memset(&ifr, 0, sizeof(ifr));
511:   strncpy(ifr.ifr_name, "wlan0", IFNAMSIZ - 1);
512: 
513:   rc = ioctl(fd, SIOCGIFADDR, &ifr);
514:   close(fd);
515:   if (rc < 0) return 0;
516: 
517:   sin = (struct sockaddr_in *)&ifr.ifr_addr;
518:   if (sin->sin_addr.s_addr == 0) return 0;
519: 
520:   return inet_ntop(AF_INET, &sin->sin_addr, out, n) != NULL;
521: }
522: 
523: /* 真实关联检测: wlan0 是否关联了 AP。
524:    用 SIOCGIWAP ioctl 直接取已关联的 AP MAC, 全 0 表示未连上任何路由器。
525:    不再用 system("wapi show wlan0"): 那会每秒 fork/exec 一次 shell,
526:    开销大且会打断 SPI 屏刷新(曾导致触摸间歇失灵)。 */
527: static int wifi_associated(void)
528: {
529:   struct iwreq   iwr;
530:   const uint8_t *mac;
531:   int            fd;
532:   int            ret;
533:   int            i;
534: 
535:   fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
536:   if (fd < 0) return 0;
537: 
538:   memset(&iwr, 0, sizeof(iwr));
539:   strncpy(iwr.ifr_name, "wlan0", IFNAMSIZ - 1);
540: 
541:   ret = ioctl(fd, SIOCGIWAP, (unsigned long)&iwr);
542:   close(fd);
543:   if (ret < 0) return 0;
544: 
545:   /* ap_addr.sa_data 前 6 字节是 AP 的 MAC */
546:   mac = (const uint8_t *)iwr.u.ap_addr.sa_data;
547:   for (i = 0; i < 6; i++)
548:     {
549:       if (mac[i] != 0) return 1;
550:     }
551: 
552:   return 0;
553: }
554: 
555: static int net_connected(void)
556: {
557:   char ip[64];
558: 
559:   memset(ip, 0, sizeof(ip));
560: 
561:   /* 必须先真正关联上路由器 */
562:   if (!wifi_associated()) return 0;
563: 
564:   if (!get_local_ip(ip, (int)sizeof(ip))) return 0;
565:   if (strncmp(ip, "127.", 4) == 0 || strcmp(ip, "0.0.0.0") == 0) return 0;
566: 
567:   snprintf(g_url, sizeof(g_url), "http://%s:%d", ip, HTTP_PORT);
568:   return 1;
569: }

722: /****************************************************************************
723:  * WiFi 连接 (选网 + 输密码 + 连接, 扫码前的网络设置)
724:  ****************************************************************************/
725: 
726: /* 解析 /tmp/wifi_scan_result.txt, 提取 SSID 列表。
727:    格式: bssid / frequency / signal level / encode / ssid
728:    第1行是标题需跳过; SSID 是前4个空格分隔字段之后的剩余部分
729:    (SSID 本身可能含空格, 不能用 strtok 简单切分)。 */
730: static int get_wifi_ssids(char ap_names[][33], int max_count)
731: {
732:   FILE *fp = fopen("/tmp/wifi_scan_result.txt", "r");
733:   if (fp == NULL) return 0;
734: 
735:   char line[256];
736:   int  count = 0;
737:   int  first = 1;
738: 
739:   while (count < max_count && fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp))
740:     {
741:       if (first) { first = 0; continue; }        /* 跳过标题行 */
742: 
743:       char *nl = strchr(line, '\n');
744:       if (nl) *nl = '\0';
745: 
746:       /* 跳过前4个字段 (bssid freq signal encode) */
747:       char *p = line;
748:       int   field = 0;
749:       while (field < 4)
750:         {
751:           while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
752:           if (*p == '\0') break;
753:           while (*p != ' ' && *p != '\t' && *p != '\0') p++;
754:           field++;
755:         }
756:       while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;       /* p 指向 SSID 起点 */
757: 
758:       /* 去掉 SSID 尾部空白 */
759:       char *end = p + strlen(p);
760:       while (end > p && (end[-1] == ' ' || end[-1] == '\t')) end--;
761:       *end = '\0';
762: 
763:       if (*p != '\0')                            /* 隐藏 SSID 的行跳过 */
764:         {
765:           strncpy(ap_names[count], p, 32);
766:           ap_names[count][32] = '\0';
767:           count++;
768:         }
769:     }
770: 
771:   fclose(fp);
772:   return count;
773: }
774: 
775: /* 扫描线程: 用 wapi C API 发起 wlan0 扫描并收集结果, 绝不触碰任何 LVGL 对象。
776:  * 之前用 system("sh /data/get_wifi.sh ...") + 解析文件, 但 NuttX 的 system()
777:  * 走 posix_spawn, 从 pthread 调用会破坏任务结构, 导致 IDLE 栈损坏 + Prefetch
778:  * abort(PC 跳到非法地址, 双核 panic)。改用库调用后无线程 spawn, 与 113 队
779:  * wifi_manager 的 "不使用 system()" 原则一致。
780:  */
781: static void *wifi_scan_thread(void *arg)
782: {
783:   struct wapi_list_s list;
784:   struct wapi_scan_info_s *info;
785:   int sock;
786:   int tries;
787:   int count = 0;
788: 
789:   LV_UNUSED(arg);
790: 
791:   memset(&list, 0, sizeof(list));
792: 
793:   sock = wapi_make_socket();
794:   if (sock < 0)
795:     {
796:       printf("[eye] wapi_make_socket: %d\n", errno);
797:       g_scan_done = 1;
798:       return NULL;
799:     }
800: 
801:   /* 主动扫描(NULL essid = 扫描所有); 等价于 wapi scan wlan0 */
802:   if (wapi_scan_init(sock, "wlan0", NULL) < 0)
803:     {
804:       printf("[eye] wapi_scan_init: %d\n", errno);
805:       close(sock);
806:       g_scan_done = 1;
807:       return NULL;
808:     }
809: 
810:   /* 等待驱动异步扫描完成, 最多 25 * 200ms = 5s(与 wapi 工具默认一致) */
811:   for (tries = 0; tries < 25; tries++)
812:     {
813:       int stat = wapi_scan_stat(sock, "wlan0");
814:       if (stat < 0)
815:         break;
816:       if (stat == 0)
817:         break;
818:       usleep(200 * 1000);
819:     }
820: 
821:   if (wapi_scan_coll(sock, "wlan0", &list) >= 0)
822:     {
823:       for (info = list.head.scan; info && count < 64; info = info->next)
824:         {
825:           if (info->has_essid == 0 || info->essid[0] == '\0')
826:             continue;   /* 隐藏 SSID 跳过 */
827:           strncpy(g_ap_names[count], info->essid, 32);
828:           g_ap_names[count][32] = '\0';
829:           count++;
830:         }
831:     }
832: 
833:   wapi_scan_coll_free(&list);
834:   close(sock);
835: 
836:   g_ap_count = count;
837:   g_scan_done = 1;
838:   return NULL;
839: }

1133: static void wifi_check_status_cb(lv_timer_t *t)
1134: {
1135:   g_wifi_tick++;
1136: 
1137:   /* 必须等到真正联网(已关联 AP 且拿到 IP):
1138:      只判断关联就收尾的话, 此时 DHCP 往往还没完成,
1139:      关闭页面后 refresh_net_ui() 会因拿不到 IP 又显示"未连接"。 */
1140:   if (net_connected())
1141:     {
1142:       lv_timer_del(t);
1143:       g_wifi_timer = NULL;
1144: 
1145:       if (g_wifi_state) lv_label_set_text(g_wifi_state, "已连接");
1146:       printf("[eye] WiFi connected\n");
1147: 
1148:       lv_timer_create(close_wifi_after_ok_cb, 1500, NULL);
1149:       return;
1150:     }
1151: 
1152:   if (g_wifi_tick >= 30)
1153:     {
1154:       lv_timer_del(t);
1155:       g_wifi_timer = NULL;
1156:       if (g_wifi_state)
1157:         lv_label_set_text(g_wifi_state, "连接失败, 请检查密码后重试");
1158:       printf("[eye] WiFi connect timeout\n");
1159:     }

1162: static void wifi_connect(const char *ssid, const char *pwd)
1163: {
1164:   if (g_pwd_sheet) lv_obj_add_flag(g_pwd_sheet, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
1165: 
1166:   if (g_wifi_state)

1170:       lv_label_set_text(g_wifi_state, buf);
1171:     }
1172: 
1173:   /* 写入配置, 固件 wifi_manager 检测到后自动执行连接 */
1174:   save_wifi_config(ssid, pwd);
1175: 
1176:   /* 每秒轮询真实联网状态(关联 + IP), 最多 30 秒 */
1177:   g_wifi_tick = 0;
1178: 
1179:   /* BUG-1 修复: 先删旧 timer, 再创建新的, 避免重连时旧 timer 干扰 */
1180:   if (g_wifi_timer != NULL)

1188: /* 主线程侧等待扫描结果, 期间 UI 保持刷新(眼睛动画/触摸不中断)。 */
1189: static void wifi_scan_wait_cb(lv_timer_t *t)
1190: {
1191:   if (!g_scan_done)
1192:     {
1193:       if (++g_scan_wait > 75)            /* 200ms * 75 = 15s 硬超时 */
1194:         {
1195:           lv_timer_del(t);
1196:           g_scan_timer = NULL;
1197:           g_ap_count   = 0;
1198: 
1199:           /* BUG-3 修复: 超时分支也要等 pthread 退出, 避免它继续写 g_ap_names */
1200:           pthread_join(g_scan_tid, NULL);
1201: 
1202:           build_wifi_list(g_wifi_list);
1203:           if (g_wifi_state)
1204:             lv_label_set_text(g_wifi_state, "扫描超时, 请返回重进");
1205:         }
1206:       return;
1207:     }
1208: 
1209:   lv_timer_del(t);
1210:   g_scan_timer = NULL;
1211:   pthread_join(g_scan_tid, NULL);
1212: 
1213:   build_wifi_list(g_wifi_list);
1214:   if (g_wifi_state) lv_label_set_text(g_wifi_state, "");
1215:   lv_obj_invalidate(g_wifi_list);
1216:   lv_refr_now(NULL);
1217: }

1219: static void open_wifi_page(void)
1220: {
1221:   pthread_attr_t attr;
1222: 
1223:   if (g_wifi_page == NULL) return;
1224: 
1225:   /* BUG-2 修复: 先等旧扫描线程退出, 避免两个 pthread 同时写 g_ap_names */
1226:   if (g_scan_timer != NULL)
1227:     {
1228:       lv_timer_del(g_scan_timer);
1229:       g_scan_timer = NULL;
1230:     }
1231:   pthread_join(g_scan_tid, NULL);
1232: 
1233:   /* 先显示页面与"正在扫描", 扫描转后台线程, UI 不再冻结 */
1234:   if (g_wifi_state) lv_label_set_text(g_wifi_state, "正在扫描...");
1235:   lv_obj_clear_flag(g_wifi_page, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
1236:   lv_obj_move_foreground(g_wifi_page);
1237:   lv_refr_now(NULL);
1238: 
1239:   lv_obj_clean(g_wifi_list);
1240: 
1241:   g_scan_done = 0;
1242:   g_scan_wait = 0;
1243:   g_ap_count  = 0;
1244: 
1245:   /* system() 会拉起 shell, 默认线程栈偏小, 显式加大 */
1246:   pthread_attr_init(&attr);
1247:   pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, 16384);
1248:   if (pthread_create(&g_scan_tid, &attr, wifi_scan_thread, NULL) != 0)
1249:     {
1250:       pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
1251:       if (g_wifi_state) lv_label_set_text(g_wifi_state, "扫描启动失败");
1252:       return;
1253:     }
1254:   pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
1255: 
1256:   if (g_scan_timer == NULL)
1257:     g_scan_timer = lv_timer_create(wifi_scan_wait_cb, 200, NULL);
1258: }

1276: static void touch_cb(lv_event_t *e)
1277: {
1278:   lv_event_code_t code = lv_event_get_code(e);
1279:   lv_point_t      p;
1280:   uint32_t        dt;
1281:   int             dx;
1282:   int             dy;
1283: 
1284:   lv_indev_get_point(lv_indev_active(), &p);
1285: 
1286:   if (code == LV_EVENT_PRESSED)
1287:     {
1288:       pressing = 1;
1289:       down_t   = lv_tick_get();
1290:       down_x   = p.x;
1291:       down_y   = p.y;
1292:     }
1293:   else if (code == LV_EVENT_PRESSING)

507: /* 轮询 wapi 状态：wlan0 关联的 ESSID 与目标一致才算真的连上 */
508: static void wifi_check_status_cb(lv_timer_t *t)
509: {
510:   char buf[96];
511:   bool connected = false;
512: 
513:   g_wifi_check_count++;
514: 
515:   int rc = system("wapi show wlan0 > /data/wifi_state.txt 2>&1");
516:   LV_UNUSED(rc);
517: 
518:   FILE *fp = fopen("/data/wifi_state.txt", "r");
519:   if (fp)
520:     {
521:       char line[160];
522:       while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp))
523:         {
524:           if (g_pending_ssid[0] != '\0' && strstr(line, g_pending_ssid))
525:             {
526:               connected = true;
527:               break;
528:             }
529:         }
530:       fclose(fp);
531:     }
532: 
533:   if (connected)
534:     {
535:       strncpy(g_wifi_ssid, g_pending_ssid, sizeof(g_wifi_ssid) - 1);
536:       g_wifi_ssid[sizeof(g_wifi_ssid) - 1] = '\0';
537:       if (g_wifi_status)
538:         lv_label_set_text(g_wifi_status, "已连接");
539:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "已连接: %s", g_wifi_ssid);
540:       wifi_banner_show(buf, 0x059669);   /* 绿色 */
541:       printf("WiFi connected: %s\n", g_wifi_ssid);
542:       lv_timer_del(t);
543:     }
544:   else if (g_wifi_check_count >= 20)
545:     {
546:       if (g_wifi_status)
547:         lv_label_set_text(g_wifi_status, "未连接");
548:       wifi_banner_show("连接超时，请检查密码后重试", 0xDC2626);  /* 红色 */
549:       printf("WiFi connect timeout: %s\n", g_pending_ssid);
550:       lv_timer_del(t);
551:     }
552: }

585: /* 解析 /tmp/wifi_scan_result.txt，提取 SSID 列表。
586:    文件格式：bssid / frequency / signal level / encode / ssid
587:    第1行为标题需跳过，第5字段(索引4)为 SSID。 */
588: static int get_wifi_ssids(char ap_names[][33], int max_count)
589: {
590:   FILE *fp = fopen("/tmp/wifi_scan_result.txt", "r");
591:   if (fp == NULL)
592:     return 0;
593: 
594:   char line[256];
595:   int count = 0;
596: 
597:   /* 跳过第一行标题 */
598:   if (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp) == NULL)
599:     {
600:       fclose(fp);
601:       return 0;
602:     }
603: 
604:   while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp) != NULL && count < max_count)
605:     {
606:       char *nl = strchr(line, '\n');
607:       if (nl)
608:         *nl = '\0';
609: 
610:       char *saveptr = NULL;
611:       char *tok = strtok_r(line, " \t", &saveptr);
612:       int field = 0;
613:       char *ssid = NULL;
614:       while (tok != NULL && field < 5)
615:         {
616:           if (field == 4)
617:             {
618:               ssid = tok;
619:               break;
620:             }
621:           tok = strtok_r(NULL, " \t", &saveptr);
622:           field++;
623:         }
624: 
625:       if (ssid)
626:         {
627:           strncpy(ap_names[count], ssid, 32);
628:           ap_names[count][32] = '\0';
629:           count++;
630:         }
631:     }
632: 
633:   fclose(fp);
634:   return count;
635: }
636: 
637: /* 真实扫描：调用板子扫描脚本，结果写入 /tmp/wifi_scan_result.txt */
638: static void wifi_scan_real(void)
639: {
640:   g_ap_count = 0;
641:   int rc = system("sh /data/get_wifi.sh > /tmp/wifi_scan_result.txt 2>/dev/null");
642:   LV_UNUSED(rc);
643:   g_ap_count = get_wifi_ssids(g_ap_names, 64);
644: }

646: /* 将 WiFi SSID 与密码写入配置文件，供板子固件联网使用 */
647: static int save_wifi_config(const char *ssid, const char *password)
648: {

664: /****************************************************************************
665:  * 设备码：首次启动生成 UUID，持久化到 /data/device_code
666:  ****************************************************************************/
667: 
668: static void generate_device_code(void)
669: {
670:   /* 尝试读取已有的设备码 */
671:   FILE *fp = fopen(DEVICE_CODE_FILE, "r");
672:   if (fp)
673:     {
674:       if (fgets(g_device_code, sizeof(g_device_code), fp))
675:         {
676:           /* 去掉换行 */
677:           char *nl = strchr(g_device_code, '\n');
678:           if (nl) *nl = '\0';
679:           if (strlen(g_device_code) >= 6)
680:             {
681:               fclose(fp);
682:               printf("Device code loaded: %s\n", g_device_code);
683:               return;
684:             }
685:         }
686:       fclose(fp);
687:     }
688: 
689:   /* 没有有效设备码，生成 8 位短码 */
690:   fp = fopen("/dev/urandom", "r");
691:   if (!fp)
692:     {
693:       srand(time(NULL));
694:       snprintf(g_device_code, sizeof(g_device_code), "%08x",
695:                (unsigned)time(NULL) ^ (rand() << 16 | rand()));
696:     }
697:   else
698:     {
699:       unsigned char rb[4];
700:       fread(rb, 1, 4, fp);
701:       fclose(fp);
702:       snprintf(g_device_code, sizeof(g_device_code), "%02x%02x%02x%02x",
703:                rb[0], rb[1], rb[2], rb[3]);
704:     }
705: 
706:   /* 保存到文件 */
707:   fp = fopen(DEVICE_CODE_FILE, "w");
708:   if (fp)
709:     {
710:       fprintf(fp, "%s\n", g_device_code);
711:       fclose(fp);
712:     }
713: 
714:   printf("Device code generated: %s\n", g_device_code);
715: }

717: /****************************************************************************
718:  * HTTP 轮询：curl GET /api/device/<code>/screen → 解析 JSON
719:  ****************************************************************************/
720: 
721: static void fetch_screen_cb(lv_timer_t *timer)
722: {
723:   LV_UNUSED(timer);
724: 
725:   /* 只在主页且 WiFi 已连接时轮询 */
726:   if (g_page != PAGE_HOME || g_wifi_ssid[0] == '\0')
727:     return;
728: 
729:   char cmd[256];
730:   snprintf(cmd, sizeof(cmd),
731:            "curl -s -m 5 http://%s:%d/api/device/%s/screen > /tmp/screen_resp.json 2>/dev/null",
732:            SERVER_HOST, SERVER_PORT, g_device_code);
733:   system(cmd);
734: 
735:   FILE *fp = fopen("/tmp/screen_resp.json", "r");
736:   if (!fp)
737:     return;
738: 
739:   char resp[512] = "";
740:   size_t n = fread(resp, 1, sizeof(resp) - 1, fp);
741:   fclose(fp);
742:   resp[n] = '\0';
743: 
744:   printf("Screen API response: %s\n", resp);
745: 
746:   /* 简单 JSON 解析：找 "type" 字段 */
747:   char *type_ptr = strstr(resp, "\"type\"");
748:   if (!type_ptr)
749:     return;
750: 
751:   /* 跳到冒号后面的值 */
752:   type_ptr = strchr(type_ptr, ':');
753:   if (!type_ptr) return;
754:   type_ptr++;
755: 
756:   /* 跳过空格和引号 */
757:   while (*type_ptr == ' ' || *type_ptr == '"') type_ptr++;
758: 
759:   if (strncmp(type_ptr, "idle", 4) == 0)
760:     {
761:       g_screen_mode = SCREEN_IDLE;
762:       if (g_status_lbl)
763:         lv_label_set_text(g_status_lbl, "等待绑定...");
764:       printf("Screen mode: idle\n");
765:     }
766:   else if (strncmp(type_ptr, "wallpaper", 9) == 0)
767:     {
768:       g_screen_mode = SCREEN_WALLPAPER;
769:       if (g_status_lbl)
770:         lv_label_set_text(g_status_lbl, "壁纸模式");
771:       printf("Screen mode: wallpaper\n");
772:       /* TODO: 下载并显示壁纸图片 */
773:     }
774:   else if (strncmp(type_ptr, "news", 4) == 0)
775:     {
776:       g_screen_mode = SCREEN_NEWS;
777:       if (g_status_lbl)
778:         lv_label_set_text(g_status_lbl, "资讯模式");
779:       printf("Screen mode: news\n");
780:       /* TODO: 下载并显示资讯截图 */
781:     }
782: }

1: """Data store for the Smart Kanban backend.
2: 
3: Uses a single data.json file. In production this would be SQLite / Redis.
4: Thread-safe via a simple file lock.
5: """
6: 
7: import json
8: import os
9: import hashlib
10: import secrets
11: import time
12: import threading
13: from datetime import datetime, timezone
14: 
15: DATA_FILE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "data.json")
16: TOKEN_TTL = 24 * 3600   # 24 hours
17: _lock = threading.Lock()
18: 
19: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
20: # Internal helpers
21: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
22: 
23: def _now_iso():
24:     return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
25: 
26: def _sha256(s: str) -> str:
27:     return hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()
28: 
29: def _token() -> str:
30:     return secrets.token_hex(32)
31: 
32: def _load() -> dict:
33:     if not os.path.exists(DATA_FILE):
34:         return {
35:             "system": {"registration_open": True},
36:             "users": {},
37:             "devices": {},
38:         }
39:     with open(DATA_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
40:         return json.load(f)
41: 
42: def _save(data: dict):
43:     os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(DATA_FILE), exist_ok=True)
44:     tmp = DATA_FILE + ".tmp"
45:     with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
46:         json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
47:     os.replace(tmp, DATA_FILE)  # atomic on most OS
48: 
49: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
50: # Users
51: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
52: 
53: def user_register(username: str, password: str) -> dict | None:
54:     """Create a user. First user is admin. Returns user dict or None."""
55:     with _lock:
56:         data = _load()
57:         if username in data["users"]:
58:             return None
59: 
60:         first = len(data["users"]) == 0
61:         token = _token()
62:         now = _now_iso()
63: 
64:         user = {
65:             "password_hash": _sha256(password),
66:             "role": "admin" if first else "user",
67:             "token": token,
68:             "token_created_at": now,
69:             "created_at": now,
70:         }
71:         data["users"][username] = user
72:         _save(data)
73:         return {"username": username, "role": user["role"], "token": token}
74: 
75: 
76: def user_login(username: str, password: str) -> dict | None:
77:     """Authenticate user. Returns {username, role, token} or None."""
78:     with _lock:
79:         data = _load()
80:         u = data["users"].get(username)
81:         if not u:
82:             return None
83:         if u["password_hash"] != _sha256(password):
84:             return None
85: 
86:         token = _token()
87:         now = _now_iso()
88:         u["token"] = token
89:         u["token_created_at"] = now
90:         _save(data)
91:         return {"username": username, "role": u["role"], "token": token}
92: 
93: 
94: def user_auth(provided_token: str | None) -> dict | None:
95:     """Validate token. Returns user dict or None."""
96:     if not provided_token:
97:         return None
98:     with _lock:
99:         data = _load()
100:         for name, u in data["users"].items():
101:             if u.get("token") == provided_token:
102:                 created = u.get("token_created_at", "2000-01-01T00:00:00")
103:                 try:
104:                     ts = datetime.fromisoformat(created).timestamp()
105:                 except ValueError:
106:                     return None
107:                 if time.time() - ts > TOKEN_TTL:
108:                     return None
109:                 return {"username": name, "role": u["role"]}
110:     return None
111: 
112: 
113: def user_list():
114:     """Admin: list all users."""
115:     with _lock:
116:         data = _load()
117:         return [
118:             {"username": n, "role": u["role"], "created_at": u["created_at"]}
119:             for n, u in data["users"].items()
120:         ]
121: 
122: 
123: def user_delete(username: str):
124:     """Admin: delete a user and unbind their devices."""
125:     with _lock:
126:         data = _load()
127:         if username not in data["users"]:
128:             return
129:         del data["users"][username]
130:         # unbind all devices owned by this user
131:         for code, dev in list(data["devices"].items()):
132:             if dev.get("owner") == username:
133:                 data["devices"].pop(code, None)
134:         _save(data)
135:

137: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
138: # System settings
139: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
140: 
141: def system_registration_open() -> bool:
142:     with _lock:
143:         return _load()["system"].get("registration_open", True)
144: 
145: 
146: def system_set_registration(open_: bool):
147:     with _lock:
148:         data = _load()

154: # Devices
155: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
156: 
157: def device_bind(username: str, device_code: str, name: str = "") -> dict | None:
158:     """Bind a device to a user. Permanent ownership."""
159:     with _lock:
160:         data = _load()
161:         dev = data["devices"].get(device_code)
162:         if dev and dev.get("owner"):
163:             return None   # already bound to someone
164:         if not dev:
165:             dev = {
166:                 "name": name or device_code[:8],
167:                 "owner": username,
168:                 "online": False,
169:                 "last_seen": None,
170:                 "config": {
171:                     "display": {"brightness": 80, "invert": False},
172:                     "eye": {"default_expr": "平静", "auto_blink": True, "follow_touch": True},
173:                     "voice": {"enabled": False, "wake_word": "小薇", "style": "友好亲切"},
174:                 },
175:             }
176:             data["devices"][device_code] = dev
177:         else:
178:             dev["owner"] = username
179:             dev["name"] = name or dev.get("name", device_code[:8])
180:         _save(data)
181:         return dev
182: 
183: 
184: def device_unbind(device_code: str, username: str | None = None) -> bool:
185:     """Unbind a device. Optional owner check."""
186:     with _lock:
187:         data = _load()
188:         dev = data["devices"].get(device_code)
189:         if not dev or not dev.get("owner"):
190:             return False
191:         if username and dev["owner"] != username:
192:             return False
193:         # clear ownership, keep config skeleton
194:         dev["owner"] = None
195:         dev["online"] = False
196:         _save(data)
197:         return True
198: 
199: 
200: def device_get(device_code: str) -> dict | None:
201:     """Get device by code."""
202:     with _lock:
203:         dev = _load()["devices"].get(device_code)
204:         return dict(dev) if dev else None

207: def device_list_by_user(username: str) -> list[dict]:
208:     """List all devices owned by a user."""

212:             {
213:                 "device_code": code,
214:                 "name": dev.get("name", code[:8]),
215:                 "online": dev.get("online", False),
216:                 "last_seen": dev.get("last_seen"),
217:             }
218:             for code, dev in data["devices"].items()

1: # 后端（Flask）— AI 眼睛助手云端服务
2: 
3: 为板端 `eye_app` 提供用户 / 设备 / 配置管理与通信接口；Web 控制台见 `web/`。
4: > 注：早期曾命名为「Smart Kanban Backend」，`app.py` 启动日志里仍残留该字符串，不影响运行。
5: 
6: ## 运行
7: 
8: ```bash
9: cd backend
10: pip install -r requirements.txt
11: python app.py
12: ```
13: 
14: 默认监听 `http://0.0.0.0:5000`，已开启 CORS（方便本地官网 / 模拟器联调）。
15: 
16: ## API
17: 
18: ### 用户 / 设备（Bearer ***REDACTED***）
19: | API | 方法 | 说明 |
20: |-----|------|------|
21: | `/api/register` | POST | 注册 `{username,password}` → `{token,user_id}` |
22: | `/api/login` | POST | 登录 `{username,password}` → `{token}` |
23: | `/api/devices` | GET | 当前用户设备列表 |
24: | `/api/devices/bind` | POST | 绑定设备码 `{device_code,name}` |
25: | `/api/devices/<code>/config` | GET / POST | 拉取 / 更新设备配置 |
26: | `/api/devices/<code>/unbind` | DELETE | 解绑 |
27: 
28: ### 板端（device_code，无鉴权）
29: | API | 方法 | 说明 |
30: |-----|------|------|
31: | `/api/device/<code>/screen` | GET | 屏配置 |
32: | `/api/device/<code>/config` | GET | 板端拉全量配置 |
33: | `/api/device/<code>/heartbeat` | POST | 心跳保活 |
34: | `/api/device/<code>/voice` | POST | **语音链路（TODO 占位）**：当前仅返回 `{"tts":"语音功能即将上线","action":null}`，尚未接入 ASR / LLM / TTS |
35: 
36: ### 管理（admin Token）
37: | API | 方法 | 说明 |
38: |-----|------|------|
39: | `/api/admin/registration` | GET / POST | 开关系统注册 |
40: | `/api/admin/users` | GET | 用户列表 |
41: | `/api/admin/users/<username>` | DELETE | 删除用户 |
42: 
43: ## 存储
44: 
45: - 开发期使用本地 `data.json`（已被 `.gitignore` 忽略，避免提交密钥）。
46: - **`/voice` 尚未实现真正的 ASR / LLM / TTS**，仅占位；接入点见 `app.py` 的 `api_device_voice()`。
47: 
48: ## 下一步
49: 
50: - 实现 `/voice`：收音频 → ASR → LLM（对话 / 意图）→ TTS，返回 `tts` 文本或音频，并据 `action` 让板端切换表情（聆听 / 说话等）。

1: # OpenVela AI 眼睛助手（队伍 193 · FirstNext）
2: 
3: > 全志 R528 开发板 + openvela（NuttX RTOS）上的桌面 **AI 助手**：屏幕上显示**两只会动的大眼睛**作为虚拟形象，通过语音与触摸与用户交互。
4: 
5: ## 一、作品简介
6: 
7: 一个会"看"、会"听"、会"说"的桌面 AI 伙伴。核心是一个表情驱动的虚拟形象——**两只大眼睛**，用眨眼、转动、思考、说话等动画表达当前状态；背后由 AI Agent（多 LLM 后端）驱动对话与任务。板载麦克风做语音输入（ASR），扬声器做语音输出（TTS），电容触摸屏可做点选交互。
8: 
9: > **关于旧文档**：本项目早期曾设想「智能信息看板」（壁纸 / RSSHub 资讯 / 天气聚合），相关方案文档（如 `比赛流程/开发进度与规划.md`）**已删除**。当前作品为 **AI 眼睛助手**（两只大眼睛虚拟形象），以下说明以本文件为准。
10: 
11: ## 二、硬件与板级事实（已逐项核对）
12: 
13: 详见 [`SPI优化与硬件适配记录.md`](./SPI优化与硬件适配记录.md)，下表为结论：
14: 
15: | 部件 | 真实型号 | 说明 |
16: |---|---|---|
17: | 主控 | **Allwinner T113-S3** | SDK / 板级目录沿用 `r528s3-dshanpi` 命名（R528 同族），不影响适配 |
18: | 屏幕 | **ST7796U2** | 3.5"，320×480，SPI 4 线（**非** ILI9341） |
19: | 触摸 | **FT6336U** | 与显示独立，走 I2C |
20: | 音频 | 板载 mic / 扬声器 | ASR + TTS |
21: 
22: 启动后运行的应用是 **`eye_app`**（由 `/data/startup.sh` 拉起），不是旧文档里的 `my_assistant`。
23: 
24: ## 三、目录结构
25: 
26: ```
27: contest2026_193_FirstNext/
28: ├── app/hello_app/            # 板端 LVGL 应用源码（eye_main.c 等，编译为 eye_app）
29: ├── board/                    # 板级配置骨架 + 生产仓改动记录（board/patches/README.md）
30: ├── backend/                  # 后端：AI Agent / 设备管理 / 配置下发
31: ├── web/                      # Web 控制台（静态页）
32: ├── logs/<github_login>/      # AI Coding 对话日志
33: ├── 比赛流程/                 # 官方竞赛文档 + 历史开发记录（部分已弃用）
34: ├── 参考资料/                 # 硬件资料、程序源码参考
35: ├── SPI优化与硬件适配记录.md   # ✅ 当前权威：SPI 屏优化与 boot 卡死根因
36: └── README.md                 # 本文件（最新主线）
37: ```
38: 
39: > 板端编译树在 openvela 生产仓，经 manifest `<linkfile>` 软链本仓 `app/hello_app` 代码，生产仓零改动。
40: > UI PC 模拟器（`d:\openvela\lvgl_sim`）不进本仓，仅本地预览。
41: 
42: ## 四、板端编译与烧录
43: 
44: ```bash
45: cd vendor/allwinnertech/lichee
46: source vela_env.sh && source envsetup.sh
47: lunch_nuttx               # 选 1 = r528s3-dshanpi
48: rm -f ../../nuttx/.config
49: m && pack                 # 编译 + 打包
50: ```
51: 
52: 产物：`lichee/out/r528s3/dshanpi_nand/rtos_nuttx_r528s3-dshanpi_uart0_256Mnand.img`
53: 
54: > **改文件树的坑**：`d:\openvela` 只是同步副本，**编译树在 WSL 的 `/home/mfskys/openvela_contest`**。所有源码 / defconfig / 启动脚本改动必须落在 WSL 构建树，否则不会进镜像（这一条曾让我们多烧了几轮无效镜像）。
55: 
56: ## 五、已知问题与修复（踩坑沉淀，避免重蹈覆辙）
57: 
58: | 问题 | 根因 | 修复 |
59: |---|---|---|
60: | **boot 卡死**，串口停在 `Skip DISP2 fb_register` 之后无输出 | 卡槽为空时 `micro_sd_initialize()` 内 `sdio_initialize(0)` 死等 | defconfig 关闭 `CONFIG_MICRO_TF` 跳过 SDIO 初始化；WiFi（`realtek_wlan_bringup`，在它之前已完成）不受影响 |
61: | 加了调试打印但**镜像里看不到** | 改错文件树：`d:\openvela` 是副本，编译树在 WSL | 改动落在 WSL 构建树 |
62: | SPI 刷新慢 / 每帧卡顿 | 原驱动写死 8 MHz，且 `lcd_lock()` 每帧全量重配 SPI | 提频至 **60 MHz**（主板支持，上限约 66 MHz，详见 SPI 优化记录）+ `drv_spi.c` 加 `freq_set` 缓存跳过"频率未变"的重配；花屏时按 `board/patches/README.md` 回退档位降频 |
63: | 启动脚本失效，`eye_app` 没起来 | NSH 截断超长行；中文注释被当成命令；CRLF 产生幽灵命令 | 脚本纯 ASCII、每行 < 60 字节、只用 LF 换行（见 `board/patches/README.md` §5） |
64: 
65: ## 六、文档导航与状态
66: 
67: | 文档 | 状态 | 说明 |
68: |---|---|---|
69: | `方案与进度.md` | ✅ 完整权威 | 全部方案 / 架构 / 硬件数据 / SPI 优化 / boot 根因 / 踩坑 / 待办（本文档详版） |
70: | `SPI优化与硬件适配记录.md` | ✅ 当前权威 | SPI 屏优化（默认 60 MHz，主板支持）与 boot 卡死根因，以它为准 |
71: | `board/patches/README.md` | ✅ 已统一 | 启动脚本 / 生产仓改动记录；SPI 频率已统一为 **60 MHz**（主板支持，上限约 66 MHz） |
72: | `README.md`（本文件） | ✅ 最新 | AI 眼睛助手主线（精简） |
73: | `app/hello_app/README.md` | ✅ 已更新 | `eye_app` 为当前主程序，`my_assistant` 已弃用 |
74: | `比赛流程/R528开发板硬件分析.md` | ⚠️ 已勘误 | 早期型号描述有误（ILI9341→ST7796U2 等），已在文首勘误 |
75: | `比赛流程/docs-dev-ai-contest-2026/` | — | 官方竞赛文档，非本作品代码 |
76: 
77: > ⚠️ **构建树偏差（2026-09-01 实测）**：WSL 构建树当前 `spi_lcd_fb.c` 的 `LCD_SPI_FREQ` 仍是 **8 MHz**，且 `CONFIG_EXAMPLES_CONTROL_CENTER=y`、`CONFIG_XIAOZHI_GUI_APP=y` 仍开启（与本文档冲突，会导致花屏与冗余进程）。编译前须先按 `方案与进度.md` §9–§10 对齐（8→60 MHz、关两项）再 `m && pack`。
78: 
79: > 注：早期「智能信息看板」方案文档（如 `比赛流程/开发进度与规划.md`）**已删除**；当前作品为 AI 眼睛助手。

78: ## 3. 硬件事实与详细数据
79: 
80: > 完整推导见 `SPI优化与硬件适配记录.md`，此处给结论与关键数字。
81: 
82: | 部件 | 真实型号 | 说明 |
83: |------|----------|------|
84: | 主控 | **Allwinner T113-S3** | SDK/板级目录沿用 `r528s3-dshanpi`（R528 同族），不影响适配 |
85: | 屏幕 | **ST7796U2** | 3.5"，320×480，SPI 4 线（**非** ILI9341） |
86: | 触摸 | **FT6336U** | 与显示独立，走 I2C（驱动沿用 FT5x06 框架） |
87: | 音频 | 板载 mic / 扬声器 | ASR + TTS 用，codec 由 `amixer` 初始化 |
88: 
89: **SPI 频率上限推导（关键数据）：**
90: 
91: - 屏幕手册 `T_SCYCW`（4-SPI 写时钟最小周期）= **15 ns** → SPI 时钟上限 **66.7 MHz**。
92: - SPI 控制器（T113）：硬上限 100 MHz；BSP 将 **60 MHz 定为「高频采样模式」阈值** `SPI_HIGH_FREQUENCY`。
93: - 时钟树：SPI1 父时钟选 `pll-periph0` = **600 MHz**，分频公式 `SPI_CLK = 600M / (M+1) / N`，向上取整（不会超频）。
94: - 可达档位（基于 600 MHz 源）：
95: 
96: | 请求 | 实际 | 判定 |
97: |------|------|------|
98: | 40 MHz | 40.000 MHz | 精确（原始保守默认） |
99: | 50 MHz | 50.000 MHz | 精确 |
100: | **60 MHz** | **60.000 MHz** | **精确，且 ≤ 屏幕 66.7 MHz 上限，周期 16.67 ns 留 11% 余量** |
101: | 66.7 MHz | 60.000 MHz | 被取整压回（CCU 无该档） |
102: | 75 MHz | 75.000 MHz | 超屏幕规格，不推荐 |
103: 
104: **结论：60 MHz 是「规格内最高且能精确产生」的工作点，主板支持。**
105:

108: ## 4. SPI 屏优化（结论）
109: 
110: **瓶颈：**
111: 1. 原驱动在 `lcd_lock()` **每帧**调用 `SPI_SETFREQUENCY`，而 `sunxi_spi_setfrequency` 无「频率未变就跳过」检查 → 每帧全量重配 SPI（父时钟切换 + FIFO reset），既慢又泄漏时钟引用。
112: 2. 频率保守：默认 8 MHz，BSP 给 LCD 的也才 40 MHz。
113: 
114: **修改（补丁存档 `board/patches/`）：**
115: - `spi_lcd_fb.c`：频率宏化 `LCD_SPI_FREQ`，值 **60000000**（默认 60 MHz）；保留逐行发送（整块发送会超 DMA 对齐缓冲导致 `xfer timeout`）。
116: - `drv_spi.c`：结构体加 `freq_set` 字段；`setfrequency` 在「频率未变」时直接返回，跳过全量重配。
117: 
118: **全屏 320×480 RGB565（307,200 字节）传输耗时：**
119: 
120: | SPI 时钟 | 全屏耗时 | 帧率 |
121: |----------|----------|------|
122: | 8 MHz（原值） | 307 ms | 3.3 fps |
123: | 24 MHz | 102 ms | 9.8 fps |
124: | 40 MHz | 61 ms | 16 fps |
125: | **60 MHz（默认）** | 41 ms | 24 fps |
126: 
127: 配合应用层**脏矩形局部刷新**（眼睛约 1/10 屏），实际动画帧率可达 30fps+。
128: 
129: **回退档位（花屏时依次调低，只改一个数重编）：**
130: ```
131: 60000000 → 50000000 → 40000000 → 24000000 → 16000000 → 8000000（原值）
132: ```
133: - 60 MHz 轻微花屏 → 50 MHz；
134: - 明显不稳 → 先调 SPI1 GPIO 驱动强度 `LEVEL2→LEVEL3`（`spi_sun8iw20.h`），仍不行再降频；
135: - 75 MHz 可生成但超屏幕 15ns 规格，不建议量产。
136:

139: ## 5. boot 卡死根因与修复
140: 
141: - **现象**：串口停在 `Skip DISP2 fb_register` 之后无输出，系统卡死。
142: - **根因**：卡槽为空时 `micro_sd_initialize()` 内 `sdio_initialize(0)` **死等**。
143: - **修复**：defconfig 关闭 `CONFIG_MICRO_TF`，跳过 SDIO 初始化；WiFi（`realtek_wlan_bringup`，在其之前已完成）不受影响。
144: - **验证**：需烧录后确认 boot 走完 `r528_late_initialize finish`。

1: # 智能信息看板方案
2: 
3: ## 项目定位
4: 
5: **项目名称**：OpenVela 智能信息看板
6: 
7: **一句话定位**：基于 R528 开发板的桌面智能信息终端，聚合资讯、美图、AI 交互于一体。
8: 
9: ---
10: 
11: ## 硬件说明
12: 
13: | 硬件 | 规格 |
14: |------|------|
15: | 主控 | R528 双核 Cortex-A7 |
16: | 屏幕 | 3.5寸 SPI LCD（320×480） |
17: | 触摸 | FT5x06 电容触摸屏 |
18: | 音频 | 播放/录制/编解码 |
19: | 网络 | WiFi + 蓝牙 |
20: | 存储 | NAND Flash + RAM |
21: 
22: ---
23: 
24: ## 核心功能
25: 
26: ### 1. 壁纸模式（默认）
27: 
28: - **用户壁纸**：自定义图片显示
29: - **世界美图**：每日自动更新精美图片（Bing/Unsplash 等图源）
30: - **定时切换**：可设置切换间隔（30秒/1分钟/5分钟等）
31: - **手动切换**：触摸/语音切换下一张
32: 
33: ### 2. 资讯模式
34: 
35: - **多种资讯源**：
36:   - 微博热榜
37:   - 知乎热榜
38:   - 历史上的今天
39:   - 科技资讯
40:   - 财经要闻
41:   - ...（可扩展）
42:

3: > 全志 R528 开发板 + openvela（NuttX RTOS）上的桌面 **AI 助手**：屏幕上显示**两只会动的大眼睛**作为虚拟形象，通过语音与触摸与用户交互。
4: 
5: ## 一、作品简介
6: 
7: 一个会"看"、会"听"、会"说"的桌面 AI 伙伴。核心是一个表情驱动的虚拟形象——**两只大眼睛**，用眨眼、转动、思考、说话等动画表达当前状态；背后由 AI Agent（多 LLM 后端）驱动对话与任务。板载麦克风做语音输入（ASR），扬声器做语音输出（TTS），电容触摸屏可做点选交互。
8: 
9: > **关于旧文档**：本项目早期曾设想「智能信息看板」（壁纸 / RSSHub 资讯 / 天气聚合），相关方案文档（如 `比赛流程/开发进度与规划.md`）**已删除**。当前作品为 **AI 眼睛助手**（两只大眼睛虚拟形象），以下说明以本文件为准。
10:

18: | 屏幕 | **ST7796U2** | 3.5"，320×480，SPI 4 线（**非** ILI9341） |

### ThorVG 是什么？

ThorVG 是一个**矢量图形渲染引擎**，不是图片库。它用于：
- 渲染 SVG 图标
- 绘制矢量图形（线条、形状、渐变等）
- 支持动画

### LVGL 内置的图标符号

LVGL 内置了 **127 个图标符号**（基于 FontAwesome）：

| 符号 | 代码 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| ⚡ | `LV_SYMBOL_CHARGE` | 充电 |
| 🔋 | `LV_SYMBOL_BATTERY_FULL` | 满电 |
| 🔋 | `LV_SYMBOL_BATTERY_3` | 3/4电 |
| 🔋 | `LV_SYMBOL_BATTERY_2` | 1/2电 |
| 🔋 | `LV_SYMBOL_BATTERY_1` | 1/4电 |
| 🔋 | `LV_SYMBOL_BATTERY_EMPTY` | 空电 |
| 🏠 | `LV_SYMBOL_HOME` | 首页 |
| ⚙️ | `LV_SYMBOL_SETTINGS` | 设置 |
| 📶 | `LV_SYMBOL_WIFI` | WiFi |
| 🔌 | `LV_SYMBOL_USB` | USB |

5: ## 一、作品简介

1: # OpenVela 智能信息看板
2: 
3: > 基于全志 R528、运行 openvela 的桌面智能信息终端
4: 
5: ## 一、作品简介
6: 
7: 3.5 寸触控屏上聚合「壁纸 + RSSHub 资讯 + AI 语音交互」，板端是纯显示器，后端负责内容生成与下发，Web 控制台管理一切配置。
8: 
9: ## 二、目录结构
10: 
11: ```
12: contest2026_193_FirstNext/
13: ├── app/hello_app/              # 板端 LVGL 应用（my_assistant_main.c）
14: ├── board/contest_board/        # 板级配置骨架
15: ├── backend/                    # Flask 后端：用户/设备/配置/RSSHub截图/AI
16: ├── web/                        # Web 控制台（静态页）
17: └── logs/<github_login>/        # AI Coding 对话日志
18: ```
19: 
20: > 板端编译树在 openvela 生产仓，通过 manifest `<linkfile>` 软链本仓代码，生产仓零改动。
21: > UI PC 模拟器（`d:\openvela\lvgl_sim`）不进本仓，仅本地预览。
22: 
23: ## 三、板端编译与烧录
24: 
25: ```bash
26: cd vendor/allwinnertech/lichee
27: source vela_env.sh && source envsetup.sh
28: lunch_nuttx               # 选 1 = r528s3-dshanpi
29: rm -f ../../nuttx/.config
30: m && pack                 # 编译 + 打包
31: ```
32: 
33: 产物：`lichee/out/r528s3/dshanpi_nand/rtos_nuttx_r528s3-dshanpi_uart0_256Mnand.img`
34: 
35: ## 四、后端
36: 
37: ```bash
38: cd backend
39: pip install -r requirements.txt
40: python app.py             # http://0.0.0.0:5000
41: ```
42:

44:

46: |-----|------|------|

168: /****************************************************************************
169:  * 像素绘制 (圆角矩形 SDF + 1px 抗锯齿)
170:  ****************************************************************************/
171: 
172: static inline uint8_t U8(uint32_t c, int s) { return (c >> s) & 0xFF; }
173: 
174: static void px_blend(int x, int y, uint8_t a, uint32_t rgb)
175: {
176:   if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= SCR_W || y >= SCR_H || a == 0) return;
177: 
178:   uint32_t bg  = scr_buf[y * SCR_W + x];
179:   uint8_t  br  = U8(bg, 16);
180:   uint8_t  bgn = U8(bg, 8);
181:   uint8_t  bb  = U8(bg, 0);
182:   uint8_t  fr  = U8(rgb, 16);
183:   uint8_t  fg  = U8(rgb, 8);
184:   uint8_t  fb  = U8(rgb, 0);
185: 
186:   uint8_t r = (uint8_t)((fr * a + br  * (255 - a)) / 255);
187:   uint8_t g = (uint8_t)((fg * a + bgn * (255 - a)) / 255);
188:   uint8_t b = (uint8_t)((fb * a + bb  * (255 - a)) / 255);
189: 
190:   scr_buf[y * SCR_W + x] = (255u << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
191: }
192: 
193: static void fill_rrect(float cx, float cy, const shape_t *s, uint32_t rgb)
194: {
195:   float hw = s->hw;
196:   float hh = s->hh;
197:   float r  = s->r;
198:   int   x;
199:   int   y;
200: 
201:   if (r > hw) r = hw;
202:   if (r > hh) r = hh;
203:   if (hw < 1.0f || hh < 1.0f) return;
204: 
205:   float th = s->rot * PI / 180.0f;
206:   float cs = cosf(th);
207:   float sn = sinf(th);
208:   float ext = sqrtf(hw * hw + hh * hh) + 3.0f;
209: 
210:   int x0 = (int)(cx - ext);
211:   int x1 = (int)(cx + ext) + 1;
212:   int y0 = (int)(cy - ext);
213:   int y1 = (int)(cy + ext) + 1;
214: 
215:   if (x0 < 0)     x0 = 0;
216:   if (y0 < 0)     y0 = 0;
217:   if (x1 > SCR_W) x1 = SCR_W;
218:   if (y1 > SCR_H) y1 = SCR_H;
219: 
220:   for (y = y0; y < y1; y++)
221:     {
222:       for (x = x0; x < x1; x++)
223:         {
224:           float dx = (x + 0.5f) - cx;
225:           float dy = (y + 0.5f) - cy;
226: 
227:           /* 屏幕 -> 局部(逆旋转) */
228:           float lx =  dx * cs + dy * sn;
229:           float ly = -dx * sn + dy * cs;
230: 
231:           float qx = fabsf(lx) - (hw - r);
232:           float qy = fabsf(ly) - (hh - r);
233:           float mx = (qx > 0) ? qx : 0;
234:           float my = (qy > 0) ? qy : 0;
235:           float outside = sqrtf(mx * mx + my * my);
236:           float inside  = (qx > qy) ? qx : qy;
237: 
238:           if (inside > 0) inside = 0;
239: 
240:           float d = outside + inside - r;
241:           float a = 0.5f - d;
242: 
243:           if (a <= 0) continue;
244:           if (a > 1) a = 1;
245: 
246:           px_blend(x, y, (uint8_t)(a * 255), rgb);
247:         }
248:     }
249: }

255: static void lerp_shape(shape_t *c, const shape_t *t, float f)
256: {
257:   c->hw  += (t->hw  - c->hw ) * f;
258:   c->hh  += (t->hh  - c->hh ) * f;
259:   c->r   += (t->r   - c->r  ) * f;
260:   c->rot += (t->rot - c->rot) * f;
261:   c->dx  += (t->dx  - c->dx ) * f;
262:   c->dy  += (t->dy  - c->dy ) * f;
263: }

276: static void compute_target(int idx, uint32_t tick, shape_t *L, shape_t *R,
277:                            int *blinking)
278: {
279:   float t = tick / 1000.0f;
280: 
281:   *blinking = (tick < g_blink_until);
282:   if (*blinking)
283:     {
284:       *L = BLINK;
285:       *R = BLINK;
286:       return;
287:     }
288: 
289:   *L = EXPRS[idx].L;
290:   *R = EXPRS[idx].R;
291: 
292:   switch (idx)
293:     {
294:       case EX_LISTENING:
295:         {
296:           float p = sinf(t * 2.2f);
297:           L->hw += 2.0f * p; L->hh += 3.5f * p;
298:           R->hw += 2.0f * p; R->hh += 3.5f * p;
299:           break;
300:         }
301:       case EX_SPEAKING:
302:         {
303:           float p = sinf(t * 9.0f);
304:           L->dy += 6.0f * p; R->dy += 6.0f * p;
305:           break;
306:         }
307:       case EX_LAUGH:
308:         {
309:           float p = sinf(t * 10.0f);
310:           L->dy += 5.0f * p; R->dy += 5.0f * p;
311:           break;
312:         }
313:       case EX_LOVE:
314:         {
315:           float p = fabsf(sinf(t * 3.0f));
316:           L->hw += 3.0f * p; L->hh += 3.0f * p;
317:           R->hw += 3.0f * p; R->hh += 3.0f * p;
318:           break;
319:         }
320:       case EX_FEAR:
321:         {
322:           float jx = (float)(rand() % 5 - 2);
323:           float jy = (float)(rand() % 5 - 2);
324:           L->dx += jx; L->dy += jy;
325:           R->dx += jx; R->dy += jy;
326:           break;
327:         }
328:       case EX_CRY:
329:         {
330:           float p = sinf(t * 12.0f);
331:           L->dy += 1.5f * p; R->dy += 1.5f * p;
332:           break;
333:         }
334:       case EX_SLEEPY:
335:         {
336:           float p = sinf(t * 0.7f);
337:           L->hh += 12.0f * p; R->hh += 12.0f * p;
338:           break;
339:         }
340:       case EX_SCAN:
341:         {
342:           float p = sinf(t * 1.2f);
343:           L->dx += 30.0f * p; R->dx += 30.0f * p;
344:           break;
345:         }
346:       case EX_LOADING:
347:         {
348:           float p = 0.35f + 0.65f * fabsf(sinf(t * 2.5f));
349:           L->hw *= p; R->hw *= p;
350:           break;
351:         }
352:       default:
353:         {
354:           float p = sinf(t * 1.5f);
355:           L->hh += 2.0f * p; R->hh += 2.0f * p;
356:           break;
357:         }
358:     }
359: }

361: /****************************************************************************
362:  * 脏矩形局部刷新
363:  * 眼睛只占屏幕约 1/10 的面积, 每帧只清/只画/只刷这一小块,
364:  * 避免全屏 153600 像素的重绘与 SPI 全屏传输。
365:  ****************************************************************************/
366: 
367: static lv_area_t g_dirty_prev;
368: static int       g_dirty_valid = 0;
369: static int       g_need_full   = 1;   /* 首帧或设置页关闭后需要整屏重绘 */
370: 
371: static void clear_area(const lv_area_t *a)
372: {
373:   int x;
374:   int y;
375: 
376:   for (y = a->y1; y <= a->y2; y++)
377:     {
378:       uint32_t *row = &scr_buf[y * SCR_W];
379: 
380:       for (x = a->x1; x <= a->x2; x++) row[x] = 0xFF000000;
381:     }
382: }
383: 
384: /* 把一只眼睛的外接矩形并入脏区(用外接圆, 覆盖任意旋转) */
385: static void union_eye_area(lv_area_t *a, float cx, float cy,
386:                            const shape_t *s)
387: {
388:   float ext = sqrtf(s->hw * s->hw + s->hh * s->hh) + 4.0f;
389:   int   x1 = (int)(cx - ext);
390:   int   y1 = (int)(cy - ext);
391:   int   x2 = (int)(cx + ext) + 1;
392:   int   y2 = (int)(cy + ext) + 1;
393: 
394:   if (x1 < 0)         x1 = 0;
395:   if (y1 < 0)         y1 = 0;
396:   if (x2 > SCR_W - 1) x2 = SCR_W - 1;
397:   if (y2 > SCR_H - 1) y2 = SCR_H - 1;
398: 
399:   if (x1 < a->x1) a->x1 = x1;
400:   if (y1 < a->y1) a->y1 = y1;
401:   if (x2 > a->x2) a->x2 = x2;
402:   if (y2 > a->y2) a->y2 = y2;
403: }
404: 
405: static void anim_cb(lv_timer_t *tm)
406: {
407:   (void)tm;
408:   uint32_t tick = lv_tick_get();
409:   int      i;
410: 
411:   /* 来自 HTTP 线程的表情切换请求(必须在 LVGL 主线程应用) */
412:   if (g_pending_expr >= 0)
413:     {
414:       set_expr(g_pending_expr);
415:       g_pending_expr = -1;
416:     }
417: 
418:   /* 设置页打开时眼睛被完全遮挡, 跳过渲染省算力 */
419:   if (g_set_open)
420:     {
421:       g_need_full = 1;
422:       return;
423:     }
424: 
425:   if (!g_need_full)
426:     {
427:       /* 局部模式: 只清上一帧的脏区, 不整屏清 */
428:       if (g_dirty_valid) clear_area(&g_dirty_prev);
429:     }
430:   else
431:     {
432:       /* 整屏模式 */
433:       for (i = 0; i < SCR_W * SCR_H; i++) scr_buf[i] = 0xFF000000;
434:     }
435: 
436:   /* 眨眼调度 */
437:   if (tick > g_next_blink && tick > g_blink_until)
438:     {
439:       g_blink_until = tick + 160;
440:       g_next_blink  = tick + 2200 + (rand() % 2800);
441:     }
442: 
443:   shape_t L;
444:   shape_t R;
445:   int     blinking;
446: 
447:   compute_target(g_expr, tick, &L, &R, &blinking);
448:   if (blinking)
449:     {
450:       g_curL = BLINK;
451:       g_curR = BLINK;
452:     }
453:   else
454:     {
455:       lerp_shape(&g_curL, &L, 0.22f);
456:       lerp_shape(&g_curR, &R, 0.22f);
457:     }
458: 
459:   g_lookx += (g_lookx_t - g_lookx) * 0.18f;
460:   g_looky += (g_looky_t - g_looky) * 0.18f;
461: 
462:   float cxL = SCR_W / 2.0f - EYE_GAP + g_lookx * 26.0f + g_curL.dx;
463:   float cxR = SCR_W / 2.0f + EYE_GAP + g_lookx * 26.0f + g_curR.dx;
464:   float cyL = EYE_CY + g_looky * 20.0f + g_curL.dy;
465:   float cyR = EYE_CY + g_looky * 20.0f + g_curR.dy;
466: 
467:   fill_rrect(cxL, cyL, &g_curL, 0xFFFFFF);
468:   fill_rrect(cxR, cyR, &g_curR, 0xFFFFFF);
469: 
470:   /* 只把眼睛占用的这块区域标脏 —— LVGL 会只刷这一块,
471:      SPI 屏驱动支持窗口寻址(LCD_SetWindows), 传输量随之大减 */
472:   lv_area_t dirty;
473: 
474:   dirty.x1 = SCR_W - 1;
475:   dirty.y1 = SCR_H - 1;
476:   dirty.x2 = 0;
477:   dirty.y2 = 0;
478:   union_eye_area(&dirty, cxL, cyL, &g_curL);
479:   union_eye_area(&dirty, cxR, cyR, &g_curR);
480: 
481:   if (g_need_full)
482:     {
483:       lv_obj_invalidate(scr_cv);
484:       g_need_full = 0;
485:     }
486:   else
487:     {
488:       if (g_dirty_valid) lv_obj_invalidate_area(scr_cv, &g_dirty_prev);
489:       lv_obj_invalidate_area(scr_cv, &dirty);
490:     }
491: 
492:   g_dirty_prev  = dirty;
493:   g_dirty_valid = 1;
494: }

496: /****************************************************************************
497:  * 网络: 获取本机 IP + 连接状态
498:  ****************************************************************************/
499: 
500: static int get_local_ip(char *out, int n)
501: {
502:   int            fd;
503:   struct ifreq   ifr;
504:   struct sockaddr_in *sin;
505:   int            rc;
506: 
507:   fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
508:   if (fd < 0) return 0;
509: 
510:   memset(&ifr, 0, sizeof(ifr));
511:   strncpy(ifr.ifr_name, "wlan0", IFNAMSIZ - 1);
512: 
513:   rc = ioctl(fd, SIOCGIFADDR, &ifr);
514:   close(fd);
515:   if (rc < 0) return 0;
516: 
517:   sin = (struct sockaddr_in *)&ifr.ifr_addr;
518:   if (sin->sin_addr.s_addr == 0) return 0;
519: 
520:   return inet_ntop(AF_INET, &sin->sin_addr, out, n) != NULL;
521: }
522: 
523: /* 真实关联检测: wlan0 是否关联了 AP。
524:    用 SIOCGIWAP ioctl 直接取已关联的 AP MAC, 全 0 表示未连上任何路由器。
525:    不再用 system("wapi show wlan0"): 那会每秒 fork/exec 一次 shell,
526:    开销大且会打断 SPI 屏刷新(曾导致触摸间歇失灵)。 */
527: static int wifi_associated(void)
528: {
529:   struct iwreq   iwr;
530:   const uint8_t *mac;
531:   int            fd;
532:   int            ret;
533:   int            i;
534: 
535:   fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
536:   if (fd < 0) return 0;
537: 
538:   memset(&iwr, 0, sizeof(iwr));
539:   strncpy(iwr.ifr_name, "wlan0", IFNAMSIZ - 1);
540: 
541:   ret = ioctl(fd, SIOCGIWAP, (unsigned long)&iwr);
542:   close(fd);
543:   if (ret < 0) return 0;
544: 
545:   /* ap_addr.sa_data 前 6 字节是 AP 的 MAC */
546:   mac = (const uint8_t *)iwr.u.ap_addr.sa_data;
547:   for (i = 0; i < 6; i++)
548:     {
549:       if (mac[i] != 0) return 1;
550:     }
551: 
552:   return 0;
553: }
554: 
555: static int net_connected(void)
556: {
557:   char ip[64];
558: 
559:   memset(ip, 0, sizeof(ip));
560: 
561:   /* 必须先真正关联上路由器 */
562:   if (!wifi_associated()) return 0;
563: 
564:   if (!get_local_ip(ip, (int)sizeof(ip))) return 0;
565:   if (strncmp(ip, "127.", 4) == 0 || strcmp(ip, "0.0.0.0") == 0) return 0;
566: 
567:   snprintf(g_url, sizeof(g_url), "http://%s:%d", ip, HTTP_PORT);
568:   return 1;
569: }

722: /****************************************************************************
723:  * WiFi 连接 (选网 + 输密码 + 连接, 扫码前的网络设置)
724:  ****************************************************************************/
725: 
726: /* 解析 /tmp/wifi_scan_result.txt, 提取 SSID 列表。
727:    格式: bssid / frequency / signal level / encode / ssid
728:    第1行是标题需跳过; SSID 是前4个空格分隔字段之后的剩余部分
729:    (SSID 本身可能含空格, 不能用 strtok 简单切分)。 */
730: static int get_wifi_ssids(char ap_names[][33], int max_count)
731: {
732:   FILE *fp = fopen("/tmp/wifi_scan_result.txt", "r");
733:   if (fp == NULL) return 0;
734: 
735:   char line[256];
736:   int  count = 0;
737:   int  first = 1;
738: 
739:   while (count < max_count && fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp))
740:     {
741:       if (first) { first = 0; continue; }        /* 跳过标题行 */
742: 
743:       char *nl = strchr(line, '\n');
744:       if (nl) *nl = '\0';
745: 
746:       /* 跳过前4个字段 (bssid freq signal encode) */
747:       char *p = line;
748:       int   field = 0;
749:       while (field < 4)
750:         {
751:           while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
752:           if (*p == '\0') break;
753:           while (*p != ' ' && *p != '\t' && *p != '\0') p++;
754:           field++;
755:         }
756:       while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;       /* p 指向 SSID 起点 */
757: 
758:       /* 去掉 SSID 尾部空白 */
759:       char *end = p + strlen(p);
760:       while (end > p && (end[-1] == ' ' || end[-1] == '\t')) end--;
761:       *end = '\0';
762: 
763:       if (*p != '\0')                            /* 隐藏 SSID 的行跳过 */
764:         {
765:           strncpy(ap_names[count], p, 32);
766:           ap_names[count][32] = '\0';
767:           count++;
768:         }
769:     }
770: 
771:   fclose(fp);
772:   return count;
773: }
774: 
775: /* 扫描线程: 用 wapi C API 发起 wlan0 扫描并收集结果, 绝不触碰任何 LVGL 对象。
776:  * 之前用 system("sh /data/get_wifi.sh ...") + 解析文件, 但 NuttX 的 system()
777:  * 走 posix_spawn, 从 pthread 调用会破坏任务结构, 导致 IDLE 栈损坏 + Prefetch
778:  * abort(PC 跳到非法地址, 双核 panic)。改用库调用后无线程 spawn, 与 113 队
779:  * wifi_manager 的 "不使用 system()" 原则一致。
780:  */
781: static void *wifi_scan_thread(void *arg)
782: {
783:   struct wapi_list_s list;
784:   struct wapi_scan_info_s *info;
785:   int sock;
786:   int tries;
787:   int count = 0;
788: 
789:   LV_UNUSED(arg);
790: 
791:   memset(&list, 0, sizeof(list));
792: 
793:   sock = wapi_make_socket();
794:   if (sock < 0)
795:     {
796:       printf("[eye] wapi_make_socket: %d\n", errno);
797:       g_scan_done = 1;
798:       return NULL;
799:     }
800: 
801:   /* 主动扫描(NULL essid = 扫描所有); 等价于 wapi scan wlan0 */
802:   if (wapi_scan_init(sock, "wlan0", NULL) < 0)
803:     {
804:       printf("[eye] wapi_scan_init: %d\n", errno);
805:       close(sock);
806:       g_scan_done = 1;
807:       return NULL;
808:     }
809: 
810:   /* 等待驱动异步扫描完成, 最多 25 * 200ms = 5s(与 wapi 工具默认一致) */
811:   for (tries = 0; tries < 25; tries++)
812:     {
813:       int stat = wapi_scan_stat(sock, "wlan0");
814:       if (stat < 0)
815:         break;
816:       if (stat == 0)
817:         break;
818:       usleep(200 * 1000);
819:     }
820: 
821:   if (wapi_scan_coll(sock, "wlan0", &list) >= 0)
822:     {
823:       for (info = list.head.scan; info && count < 64; info = info->next)
824:         {
825:           if (info->has_essid == 0 || info->essid[0] == '\0')
826:             continue;   /* 隐藏 SSID 跳过 */
827:           strncpy(g_ap_names[count], info->essid, 32);
828:           g_ap_names[count][32] = '\0';
829:           count++;
830:         }
831:     }
832: 
833:   wapi_scan_coll_free(&list);
834:   close(sock);
835: 
836:   g_ap_count = count;
837:   g_scan_done = 1;
838:   return NULL;
839: }

841: /* 写配置文件。注意: 与固件 wifi_manager 的解析一致, 不带引号 */
842: static int save_wifi_config(const char *ssid, const char *password)
843: {
844:   FILE *fp = fopen("/data/wifi.cfg", "w");
845:   if (fp == NULL)
846:     {
847:       printf("[eye] Failed to open /data/wifi.cfg for writing\n");
848:       return -1;
849:     }
850: 
851:   fprintf(fp, "SSID=%s\n", ssid ? ssid : "");
852:   fprintf(fp, "PASSWORD=%s\n", password ? password : "");
853:   fclose(fp);
854: 
855:   printf("[eye] WiFi config saved: SSID=%s\n", ssid ? ssid : "");
856:   return 0;
857: }

1219: static void open_wifi_page(void)
1220: {
1221:   pthread_attr_t attr;
1222: 
1223:   if (g_wifi_page == NULL) return;
1224: 
1225:   /* BUG-2 修复: 先等旧扫描线程退出, 避免两个 pthread 同时写 g_ap_names */
1226:   if (g_scan_timer != NULL)
1227:     {
1228:       lv_timer_del(g_scan_timer);
1229:       g_scan_timer = NULL;
1230:     }
1231:   pthread_join(g_scan_tid, NULL);
1232: 
1233:   /* 先显示页面与"正在扫描", 扫描转后台线程, UI 不再冻结 */
1234:   if (g_wifi_state) lv_label_set_text(g_wifi_state, "正在扫描...");
1235:   lv_obj_clear_flag(g_wifi_page, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
1236:   lv_obj_move_foreground(g_wifi_page);
1237:   lv_refr_now(NULL);
1238: 
1239:   lv_obj_clean(g_wifi_list);
1240: 
1241:   g_scan_done = 0;
1242:   g_scan_wait = 0;
1243:   g_ap_count  = 0;
1244: 
1245:   /* system() 会拉起 shell, 默认线程栈偏小, 显式加大 */
1246:   pthread_attr_init(&attr);
1247:   pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, 16384);
1248:   if (pthread_create(&g_scan_tid, &attr, wifi_scan_thread, NULL) != 0)
1249:     {
1250:       pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
1251:       if (g_wifi_state) lv_label_set_text(g_wifi_state, "扫描启动失败");
1252:       return;
1253:     }
1254:   pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
1255: 
1256:   if (g_scan_timer == NULL)
1257:     g_scan_timer = lv_timer_create(wifi_scan_wait_cb, 200, NULL);
1258: }

1276: static void touch_cb(lv_event_t *e)
1277: {
1278:   lv_event_code_t code = lv_event_get_code(e);
1279:   lv_point_t      p;
1280:   uint32_t        dt;
1281:   int             dx;
1282:   int             dy;
1283: 
1284:   lv_indev_get_point(lv_indev_active(), &p);
1285: 
1286:   if (code == LV_EVENT_PRESSED)
1287:     {
1288:       pressing = 1;
1289:       down_t   = lv_tick_get();
1290:       down_x   = p.x;
1291:       down_y   = p.y;
1292:     }
1293:   else if (code == LV_EVENT_PRESSING)
1294:     {
1295:       if (!pressing) return;
1296: 
1297:       /* 眼睛跟随手指 */
1298:       g_lookx_t = ((float)p.x - SCR_W / 2.0f) / (SCR_W / 2.0f) * 0.9f;
1299:       g_looky_t = ((float)p.y - EYE_CY) / (SCR_H / 2.0f) * 0.9f;
1300:     }
1301:   else if (code == LV_EVENT_RELEASED)
1302:     {
1303:       if (!pressing) return;
1304: 
1305:       pressing = 0;
1306:       dt = lv_tick_get() - down_t;
1307:       dx = p.x - down_x;
1308:       dy = p.y - down_y;
1309: 
1310:       /* 顶部下滑 -> 打开设置页; 设置页内下滑 -> 关闭 */
1311:       if (down_y < TOP_BAR_H && dy > 45 && !g_set_open)
1312:         {
1313:           g_lookx_t = 0; g_looky_t = 0;
1314:           open_settings();
1315:           return;
1316:         }
1317: 
1318:       if (g_set_open && dy > 45)
1319:         {
1320:           g_lookx_t = 0; g_looky_t = 0;
1321:           close_settings();
1322:           return;
1323:         }
1324: 
1325:       if (dt < 320 && abs(dx) < 12 && abs(dy) < 12)
1326:         {
1327:           set_expr((g_expr + 1) % EX_N);      /* 短按: 下一个表情 */
1328:         }
1329: 
1330:       g_lookx_t = 0; g_looky_t = 0;           /* 松手回正 */
1331:     }
1332: }

1362: static void *http_thread(void *arg)
1363: {
1364:   int                srv;
1365:   int                opt = 1;
1366:   struct sockaddr_in a;
1367: 
1368:   (void)arg;
1369: 
1370:   srv = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
1371:   if (srv < 0) return NULL;
1372: 
1373:   setsockopt(srv, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &opt, sizeof(opt));
1374: 
1375:   memset(&a, 0, sizeof(a));
1376:   a.sin_family      = AF_INET;
1377:   a.sin_port        = htons(HTTP_PORT);
1378:   a.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_ANY);
1379: 
1380:   if (bind(srv, (struct sockaddr *)&a, sizeof(a)) < 0)
1381:     {
1382:       close(srv);
1383:       return NULL;
1384:     }
1385: 
1386:   if (listen(srv, 4) < 0)
1387:     {
1388:       close(srv);
1389:       return NULL;
1390:     }
1391: 
1392:   printf("[eye] HTTP server on port %d\n", HTTP_PORT);
1393: 
1394:   while (1)
1395:     {
1396:       int  c = accept(srv, NULL, NULL);
1397:       char buf[2048];
1398:       int  n;
1399: 
1400:       if (c < 0) continue;
1401: 
1402:       n = recv(c, buf, (int)sizeof(buf) - 1, 0);
1403:       if (n > 0)
1404:         {
1405:           buf[n] = 0;
1406: 
1407:           if (strncmp(buf, "GET /api/expr?i=", 16) == 0)
1408:             {
1409:               const char *ok = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n"
1410:                                "Connection: close\r\n\r\nok";
1411:               g_pending_expr = atoi(buf + 16);
1412:               send(c, ok, strlen(ok), 0);
1413:             }
1414:           else if (strncmp(buf, "GET /api/state", 14) == 0)
1415:             {
1416:               char body[128];
1417:               char head[160];
1418:               int  bl;
1419: 
1420:               snprintf(body, sizeof(body), "{\"name\":\"%s\"}",

507: /* 轮询 wapi 状态：wlan0 关联的 ESSID 与目标一致才算真的连上 */
508: static void wifi_check_status_cb(lv_timer_t *t)
509: {
510:   char buf[96];
511:   bool connected = false;
512: 
513:   g_wifi_check_count++;
514: 
515:   int rc = system("wapi show wlan0 > /data/wifi_state.txt 2>&1");
516:   LV_UNUSED(rc);
517: 
518:   FILE *fp = fopen("/data/wifi_state.txt", "r");
519:   if (fp)
520:     {
521:       char line[160];
522:       while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp))
523:         {
524:           if (g_pending_ssid[0] != '\0' && strstr(line, g_pending_ssid))
525:             {
526:               connected = true;
527:               break;
528:             }
529:         }
530:       fclose(fp);
531:     }
532: 
533:   if (connected)
534:     {
535:       strncpy(g_wifi_ssid, g_pending_ssid, sizeof(g_wifi_ssid) - 1);
536:       g_wifi_ssid[sizeof(g_wifi_ssid) - 1] = '\0';
537:       if (g_wifi_status)
538:         lv_label_set_text(g_wifi_status, "已连接");
539:       snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "已连接: %s", g_wifi_ssid);
540:       wifi_banner_show(buf, 0x059669);   /* 绿色 */
541:       printf("WiFi connected: %s\n", g_wifi_ssid);
542:       lv_timer_del(t);
543:     }
544:   else if (g_wifi_check_count >= 20)
545:     {
546:       if (g_wifi_status)
547:         lv_label_set_text(g_wifi_status, "未连接");
548:       wifi_banner_show("连接超时，请检查密码后重试", 0xDC2626);  /* 红色 */
549:       printf("WiFi connect timeout: %s\n", g_pending_ssid);
550:       lv_timer_del(t);
551:     }
552: }

585: /* 解析 /tmp/wifi_scan_result.txt，提取 SSID 列表。
586:    文件格式：bssid / frequency / signal level / encode / ssid
587:    第1行为标题需跳过，第5字段(索引4)为 SSID。 */
588: static int get_wifi_ssids(char ap_names[][33], int max_count)
589: {
590:   FILE *fp = fopen("/tmp/wifi_scan_result.txt", "r");
591:   if (fp == NULL)
592:     return 0;
593: 
594:   char line[256];
595:   int count = 0;
596: 
597:   /* 跳过第一行标题 */
598:   if (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp) == NULL)
599:     {
600:       fclose(fp);
601:       return 0;
602:     }
603: 
604:   while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp) != NULL && count < max_count)
605:     {
606:       char *nl = strchr(line, '\n');
607:       if (nl)
608:         *nl = '\0';
609: 
610:       char *saveptr = NULL;
611:       char *tok = strtok_r(line, " \t", &saveptr);
612:       int field = 0;
613:       char *ssid = NULL;
614:       while (tok != NULL && field < 5)
615:         {
616:           if (field == 4)
617:             {
618:               ssid = tok;
619:               break;
620:             }
621:           tok = strtok_r(NULL, " \t", &saveptr);
622:           field++;
623:         }
624: 
625:       if (ssid)
626:         {
627:           strncpy(ap_names[count], ssid, 32);
628:           ap_names[count][32] = '\0';
629:           count++;
630:         }
631:     }
632: 
633:   fclose(fp);
634:   return count;
635: }
636: 
637: /* 真实扫描：调用板子扫描脚本，结果写入 /tmp/wifi_scan_result.txt */
638: static void wifi_scan_real(void)
639: {
640:   g_ap_count = 0;
641:   int rc = system("sh /data/get_wifi.sh > /tmp/wifi_scan_result.txt 2>/dev/null");
642:   LV_UNUSED(rc);
643:   g_ap_count = get_wifi_ssids(g_ap_names, 64);
644: }

664: /****************************************************************************
665:  * 设备码：首次启动生成 UUID，持久化到 /data/device_code
666:  ****************************************************************************/
667: 
668: static void generate_device_code(void)
669: {
670:   /* 尝试读取已有的设备码 */
671:   FILE *fp = fopen(DEVICE_CODE_FILE, "r");
672:   if (fp)
673:     {
674:       if (fgets(g_device_code, sizeof(g_device_code), fp))
675:         {
676:           /* 去掉换行 */
677:           char *nl = strchr(g_device_code, '\n');
678:           if (nl) *nl = '\0';
679:           if (strlen(g_device_code) >= 6)
680:             {
681:               fclose(fp);
682:               printf("Device code loaded: %s\n", g_device_code);
683:               return;
684:             }
685:         }
686:       fclose(fp);
687:     }
688: 
689:   /* 没有有效设备码，生成 8 位短码 */
690:   fp = fopen("/dev/urandom", "r");
691:   if (!fp)
692:     {
693:       srand(time(NULL));
694:       snprintf(g_device_code, sizeof(g_device_code), "%08x",
695:                (unsigned)time(NULL) ^ (rand() << 16 | rand()));
696:     }
697:   else
698:     {
699:       unsigned char rb[4];
700:       fread(rb, 1, 4, fp);
701:       fclose(fp);
702:       snprintf(g_device_code, sizeof(g_device_code), "%02x%02x%02x%02x",
703:                rb[0], rb[1], rb[2], rb[3]);
704:     }
705: 
706:   /* 保存到文件 */
707:   fp = fopen(DEVICE_CODE_FILE, "w");
708:   if (fp)
709:     {
710:       fprintf(fp, "%s\n", g_device_code);
711:       fclose(fp);
712:     }
713: 
714:   printf("Device code generated: %s\n", g_device_code);
715: }

717: /****************************************************************************
718:  * HTTP 轮询：curl GET /api/device/<code>/screen → 解析 JSON
719:  ****************************************************************************/
720: 
721: static void fetch_screen_cb(lv_timer_t *timer)
722: {
723:   LV_UNUSED(timer);
724: 
725:   /* 只在主页且 WiFi 已连接时轮询 */
726:   if (g_page != PAGE_HOME || g_wifi_ssid[0] == '\0')
727:     return;
728: 
729:   char cmd[256];
730:   snprintf(cmd, sizeof(cmd),
731:            "curl -s -m 5 http://%s:%d/api/device/%s/screen > /tmp/screen_resp.json 2>/dev/null",
732:            SERVER_HOST, SERVER_PORT, g_device_code);
733:   system(cmd);
734: 
735:   FILE *fp = fopen("/tmp/screen_resp.json", "r");
736:   if (!fp)
737:     return;
738: 
739:   char resp[512] = "";
740:   size_t n = fread(resp, 1, sizeof(resp) - 1, fp);
741:   fclose(fp);
742:   resp[n] = '\0';
743: 
744:   printf("Screen API response: %s\n", resp);
745: 
746:   /* 简单 JSON 解析：找 "type" 字段 */
747:   char *type_ptr = strstr(resp, "\"type\"");
748:   if (!type_ptr)
749:     return;
750: 
751:   /* 跳到冒号后面的值 */
752:   type_ptr = strchr(type_ptr, ':');
753:   if (!type_ptr) return;
754:   type_ptr++;
755: 
756:   /* 跳过空格和引号 */
757:   while (*type_ptr == ' ' || *type_ptr == '"') type_ptr++;
758: 
759:   if (strncmp(type_ptr, "idle", 4) == 0)
760:     {
761:       g_screen_mode = SCREEN_IDLE;
762:       if (g_status_lbl)
763:         lv_label_set_text(g_status_lbl, "等待绑定...");
764:       printf("Screen mode: idle\n");
765:     }
766:   else if (strncmp(type_ptr, "wallpaper", 9) == 0)
767:     {
768:       g_screen_mode = SCREEN_WALLPAPER;
769:       if (g_status_lbl)
770:         lv_label_set_text(g_status_lbl, "壁纸模式");
771:       printf("Screen mode: wallpaper\n");
772:       /* TODO: 下载并显示壁纸图片 */
773:     }
774:   else if (strncmp(type_ptr, "news", 4) == 0)
775:     {
776:       g_screen_mode = SCREEN_NEWS;
777:       if (g_status_lbl)
778:         lv_label_set_text(g_status_lbl, "资讯模式");
779:       printf("Screen mode: news\n");
780:       /* TODO: 下载并显示资讯截图 */
781:     }
782: }

1: """Data store for the Smart Kanban backend.
2: 
3: Uses a single data.json file. In production this would be SQLite / Redis.
4: Thread-safe via a simple file lock.
5: """
6: 
7: import json
8: import os
9: import hashlib
10: import secrets
11: import time
12: import threading
13: from datetime import datetime, timezone
14: 
15: DATA_FILE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "data.json")
16: TOKEN_TTL = 24 * 3600   # 24 hours
17: _lock = threading.Lock()
18: 
19: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
20: # Internal helpers
21: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
22: 
23: def _now_iso():
24:     return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
25: 
26: def _sha256(s: str) -> str:
27:     return hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()
28: 
29: def _token() -> str:
30:     return secrets.token_hex(32)
31: 
32: def _load() -> dict:
33:     if not os.path.exists(DATA_FILE):
34:         return {
35:             "system": {"registration_open": True},
36:             "users": {},
37:             "devices": {},
38:         }
39:     with open(DATA_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
40:         return json.load(f)
41: 
42: def _save(data: dict):
43:     os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(DATA_FILE), exist_ok=True)
44:     tmp = DATA_FILE + ".tmp"
45:     with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
46:         json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
47:     os.replace(tmp, DATA_FILE)  # atomic on most OS
48: 
49: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
50: # Users
51: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
52: 
53: def user_register(username: str, password: str) -> dict | None:
54:     """Create a user. First user is admin. Returns user dict or None."""
55:     with _lock:
56:         data = _load()
57:         if username in data["users"]:
58:             return None
59: 
60:         first = len(data["users"]) == 0
61:         token = _token()
62:         now = _now_iso()
63: 
64:         user = {
65:             "password_hash": _sha256(password),
66:             "role": "admin" if first else "user",
67:             "token": token,
68:             "token_created_at": now,
69:             "created_at": now,
70:         }
71:         data["users"][username] = user
72:         _save(data)
73:         return {"username": username, "role": user["role"], "token": token}
74: 
75: 
76: def user_login(username: str, password: str) -> dict | None:
77:     """Authenticate user. Returns {username, role, token} or None."""
78:     with _lock:
79:         data = _load()
80:         u = data["users"].get(username)
81:         if not u:
82:             return None
83:         if u["password_hash"] != _sha256(password):
84:             return None
85: 
86:         token = _token()
87:         now = _now_iso()
88:         u["token"] = token
89:         u["token_created_at"] = now
90:         _save(data)
91:         return {"username": username, "role": u["role"], "token": token}
92: 
93: 
94: def user_auth(provided_token: str | None) -> dict | None:
95:     """Validate token. Returns user dict or None."""
96:     if not provided_token:
97:         return None
98:     with _lock:
99:         data = _load()
100:         for name, u in data["users"].items():
101:             if u.get("token") == provided_token:
102:                 created = u.get("token_created_at", "2000-01-01T00:00:00")
103:                 try:
104:                     ts = datetime.fromisoformat(created).timestamp()
105:                 except ValueError:
106:                     return None
107:                 if time.time() - ts > TOKEN_TTL:
108:                     return None
109:                 return {"username": name, "role": u["role"]}
110:     return None
111: 
112: 
113: def user_list():
114:     """Admin: list all users."""
115:     with _lock:
116:         data = _load()
117:         return [
118:             {"username": n, "role": u["role"], "created_at": u["created_at"]}
119:             for n, u in data["users"].items()
120:         ]
121: 
122: 
123: def user_delete(username: str):
124:     """Admin: delete a user and unbind their devices."""
125:     with _lock:
126:         data = _load()
127:         if username not in data["users"]:
128:             return
129:         del data["users"][username]
130:         # unbind all devices owned by this user
131:         for code, dev in list(data["devices"].items()):
132:             if dev.get("owner") == username:
133:                 data["devices"].pop(code, None)
134:         _save(data)
135: 
136: 
137: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
138: # System settings
139: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
140: 
141: def system_registration_open() -> bool:
142:     with _lock:
143:         return _load()["system"].get("registration_open", True)
144: 
145: 
146: def system_set_registration(open_: bool):
147:     with _lock:
148:         data = _load()
149:         data["system"]["registration_open"] = open_
150:         _save(data)
151: 
152: 
153: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
154: # Devices
155: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
156: 
157: def device_bind(username: str, device_code: str, name: str = "") -> dict | None:
158:     """Bind a device to a user. Permanent ownership."""
159:     with _lock:
160:         data = _load()
161:         dev = data["devices"].get(device_code)
162:         if dev and dev.get("owner"):
163:             return None   # already bound to someone
164:         if not dev:
165:             dev = {
166:                 "name": name or device_code[:8],
167:                 "owner": username,
168:                 "online": False,
169:                 "last_seen": None,
170:                 "config": {
171:                     "display": {"brightness": 80, "invert": False},
172:                     "eye": {"default_expr": "平静", "auto_blink": True, "follow_touch": True},
173:                     "voice": {"enabled": False, "wake_word": "小薇", "style": "友好亲切"},
174:                 },
175:             }
176:             data["devices"][device_code] = dev
177:         else:
178:             dev["owner"] = username
179:             dev["name"] = name or dev.get("name", device_code[:8])
180:         _save(data)
181:         return dev
182: 
183: 
184: def device_unbind(device_code: str, username: str | None = None) -> bool:
185:     """Unbind a device. Optional owner check."""
186:     with _lock:
187:         data = _load()
188:         dev = data["devices"].get(device_code)
189:         if not dev or not dev.get("owner"):
190:             return False
191:         if username and dev["owner"] != username:
192:             return False
193:         # clear ownership, keep config skeleton
194:         dev["owner"] = None
195:         dev["online"] = False
196:         _save(data)
197:         return True
198: 
199: 
200: def device_get(device_code: str) -> dict | None:
201:     """Get device by code."""
202:     with _lock:
203:         dev = _load()["devices"].get(device_code)
204:         return dict(dev) if dev else None
205: 
206: 
207: def device_list_by_user(username: str) -> list[dict]:
208:     """List all devices owned by a user."""
209:     with _lock:
210:         data = _load()
211:         return [
212:             {
213:                 "device_code": code,
214:                 "name": dev.get("name", code[:8]),
215:                 "online": dev.get("online", False),
216:                 "last_seen": dev.get("last_seen"),
217:             }
218:             for code, dev in data["devices"].items()
219:             if dev.get("owner") == username
220:         ]
221: 
222: 
223: def device_config_get(device_code: str) -> dict | None:
224:     """Get device config. (Web console, authed)."""
225:     dev = device_get(device_code)
226:     if not dev:
227:         return None
228:     return dev.get("config", {})
229: 
230: 
231: def device_config_set(device_code: str, config: dict):
232:     """Merge config into device. (Web console, authed)."""
233:     with _lock:
234:         data = _load()
235:         dev = data["devices"].get(device_code)
236:         if not dev:
237:             return
238:         existing = dev.get("config", {})
239:         _deep_merge(existing, config)
240:         dev["config"] = existing
241:         _save(data)
242: 
243: 
244: def device_screen(device_code: str) -> dict:
245:     """Board API: return current screen content."""
246:     dev = device_get(device_code)
247:     if not dev:
248:         return {"type": "idle", "url": "/static/idle.png"}
249:     # For now: return simple placeholder based on config mode
250:     mode = dev.get("config", {}).get("mode", "wallpaper")
251:     return {"type": mode, "url": f"/static/{mode}_placeholder.png"}
252: 
253: 
254: def device_heartbeat(device_code: str):
255:     """Board API: mark device online."""
256:     with _lock:
257:         data = _load()
258:         dev = data["devices"].get(device_code)
259:         if not dev:
260:             return
261:         dev["online"] = True
262:         dev["last_seen"] = _now_iso()
263:         _save(data)
264: 
265: 
266: def device_config_get_for_board(device_code: str) -> dict | None:
267:     """Board API: get config without auth."""
268:     dev = device_get(device_code)
269:     if not dev:
270:         return None
271:     return dev.get("config", {})
272: 
273: 
274: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
275: # Utility
276: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
277: 
278: def _deep_merge(base: dict, overlay: dict):
279:     """Merge overlay into base in-place."""
280:     for k, v in overlay.items():
281:         if isinstance(v, dict) and isinstance(base.get(k), dict):
282:             _deep_merge(base[k], v)
283:         else:
284:             base[k] = v

1: # 后端（Flask）— AI 眼睛助手云端服务
2: 
3: 为板端 `eye_app` 提供用户 / 设备 / 配置管理与通信接口；Web 控制台见 `web/`。
4: > 注：早期曾命名为「Smart Kanban Backend」，`app.py` 启动日志里仍残留该字符串，不影响运行。
5: 
6: ## 运行
7: 
8: ```bash
9: cd backend
10: pip install -r requirements.txt
11: python app.py
12: ```
13: 
14: 默认监听 `http://0.0.0.0:5000`，已开启 CORS（方便本地官网 / 模拟器联调）。
15: 
16: ## API
17:

20: |-----|------|------|
21: | `/api/register` | POST | 注册 `{username,password}` → `{token,user_id}` |
22: | `/api/login` | POST | 登录 `{username,password}` → `{token}` |
23: | `/api/devices` | GET | 当前用户设备列表 |

25: | `/api/devices/<code>/config` | GET / POST | 拉取 / 更新设备配置 |

28: ### 板端（device_code，无鉴权）

46: - **`/voice` 尚未实现真正的 ASR / LLM / TTS**，仅占位；接入点见 `app.py` 的 `api_device_voice()`。

48: ## 下一步

50: - 实现 `/voice`：收音频 → ASR → LLM（对话 / 意图）→ TTS，返回 `tts` 文本或音频，并据 `action` 让板端切换表情（聆听 / 说话等）。
